data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ح-س-ن (ḥ-s-n), 'to be good'. Muḥsin means 'beneficent'. Its root is ح-س-ن (ḥ-s-n). A Qur'anic term; a common Muslim name. Mohsin is a Arabic name meaning “Beneficent; charitable”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mohsin expresses “Beneficent; charitable”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ح-س-ن (ḥ-s-n), 'to be good'. Muḥsin means 'beneficent'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mohsin total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
